title: 第13章 初次撒谎第14章 兄妹分别
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
走出祝余学院，楚少野先是到了一家收购灵兽材料的店铺中，他对伙计道：“我家公子刚刚狩猎回来，有一批灵丹要卖，不知道现在是什么价格？”
伙计看他虽然年纪小，但气定神闲，通身的气质确实是像大家族出来的，便没有轻视之意，老老实实将价格报了出来。
“客官，我们店现在收购灵丹的价格是，两银币一枚一阶灵丹，一金币一枚二阶灵丹，三金币一枚三阶灵丹……”
楚少野点了点头，这个价格比霜月告诉他的还要高一点。
他摸了下黑玉戒，拿了十枚一阶灵丹还有两枚二阶灵丹出来，这十二枚灵丹全部都是火属性的，在拿出来的那一刻，整个铺子都热了起来。
伙计看到他用的是储物戒指，心里一惊，这可不是普通人能用得上的。
而且十几枚灵丹算得上是笔大生意了，他做不了主，急忙将掌柜请了出来。
掌柜查看过灵丹后，对楚少野道：“这位客官，您的这些灵丹品质都非常好，我们愿意加一点价格收购。”
“原本十枚一阶灵丹，两枚二阶灵丹应该是二十银币两金币，我愿意出五十银币两金币的价格收购，您看怎么样？”
楚少野点点头，像是做惯了一般，平淡说道：“多出来的银币给我换成铜币。”
掌柜了然，这是要捞点油水，这下更信楚少野是某位大人物的手下了。
伙计将钱点清，楚少野用带黑玉戒的手一挥，便将钱都装了起来。
掌柜瞳孔一缩，果然是储物戒指。
他将楚少野送到门口，脸上带着谄媚的笑容，“客官，下次再来照顾小店的生意，在下依旧出高价收购。”
楚少野无所谓道：“看我们公子的意思吧，我也不知道他下次想去哪儿游历。”
等走远了，确定掌柜看不到他，楚少野才默默松了一口气，这还是他第一次说这么多谎。
在霜月的教导下，楚少野深知财不外露的道理，只好捏造了这么一个实力高强的“公子”
形象，让人知道他有人罩着，不敢轻易起坏心。
从掌柜和伙计的反应看，他这次的表演很成功。
楚少野从戒指中取了一部分钱装到普通的钱袋里，转身又进了一个店铺。

这家店铺是专门卖储物灵器的，店内摆了一圈玻璃展柜，里面摆满了各式各样的储物灵器。
大部分灵主用的都是最基础的储物袋，品阶一般在一到三阶，储物袋价格便宜，相应的储物空间也小，无法存放活物，无法认主，丢失后基本就找不回来了。
像楚少野带的这枚黑玉戒，虽然外表朴实无华，看上去就是个普通戒指，但实则是七阶的储物灵器，如果拍卖的话将会是一个天价，而且还是有价无市。
楚少野在店铺里看了一圈，发现最高品阶的储物灵器也就只有五阶，除了造型精美之外，在功能方面完全无法和黑玉戒相比。
不过楚少野这次只是想买个最普通的储物袋平时使用，每次都从黑玉戒中拿东西的话，难免会被有心之人盯上。
他随便挑了一个银灰色的一阶储物，又挑了一个蓝色和一个绿色的，一共买了三个，共花了三十枚银币。
content_en:
After leaving Zhu Yu Academy, Chu Shaoye first went to a shop that purchased spiritual beast materials. He said to the clerk: "My young master just came back from hunting and has a batch of spiritual pills to sell. I wonder what the price is now?"
The waiter saw that although he was young, he was calm and composed, and his temperament really looked like he came from a big family, so he did not look down upon him and quoted the price honestly.
"Sir, the current price for purchasing elixirs in our store is two silver coins for a first-level elixir, one gold coin for a second-level elixir, and three gold coins for a third-level elixir..."
Chu Shaoye nodded, the price was a little higher than Shuangyue told him.
He touched the black jade ring and took out ten first-level elixirs and two second-level elixirs. These twelve elixirs were all of fire attribute. The moment he took them out, the whole shop became hot.
The boy was shocked when he saw that he was using a storage ring. This was not something that ordinary people could use.
Moreover, a dozen elixirs were considered a big deal. He couldn't make the decision, so he hurriedly invited the shopkeeper out.
After checking the elixirs, the shopkeeper said to Chu Shaoye: "Sir, these elixirs of yours are of very good quality. We are willing to pay a little more for them."
"Originally ten first-level elixirs and two second-level elixirs should cost twenty silver coins and two gold coins. I am willing to pay fifty silver coins and two gold coins for them. What do you think?"
Chu Shaoye nodded, as if he was used to it, and said calmly: "Exchange the extra silver coins for me into copper coins."
The shopkeeper understood that this was to make some money, and now he believed that Chu Shaoye was the subordinate of a certain big shot.
The clerk counted the money, and Chu Shaoye put all the money away with a wave of his hand with a black jade ring.
The shopkeeper's pupils shrank, it turned out to be a storage ring.
He sent Chu Shaoye to the door with a flattering smile on his face, "Sir, next time you come to take care of the business of the store, I will still pay a high price for the purchase."
Chu Shaoye said indifferently: "It depends on what our young master wants. I don't know where he wants to travel next time."
After walking far away and making sure that the shopkeeper couldn't see him, Chu Shaoye breathed a sigh of relief silently. This was the first time he had told so many lies.
Under Shuangyue's guidance, Chu Shaoye knew well that wealth should not be exposed, so he had to fabricate such a powerful "gongzi"
The image lets people know that he is protected and does not dare to have bad intentions easily.
Judging from the reaction of the shopkeeper and the waiters, his performance this time was very successful.
Chu Shaoye took some money from the ring and put it into an ordinary purse, then turned around and entered another shop.
This shop specializes in selling magical storage devices. There is a circle of glass display cabinets in the store, filled with various kinds of magical storage devices.
Most spirit owners use the most basic storage bags, which are generally in the first to third levels. The storage bags are cheap and the corresponding storage space is small. They cannot store living objects, cannot identify the owner, and basically cannot be retrieved if lost.
For example, the black jade ring worn by Chu Shaoye, although it looks plain and simple and looks like an ordinary ring, is actually a seventh-level spiritual storage device. If it is auctioned, it will fetch a sky-high price, and it is still expensive but has no market.
Chu Shaoye looked around the store and found that the highest-grade storage spiritual weapon was only fifth-grade. In addition to its exquisite shape, it was completely incomparable to the black jade ring in terms of functionality.
However, Chu Shaoye just wanted to buy the most ordinary storage bag for daily use this time. If he took something from the black jade ring every time, he would inevitably be targeted by someone with intentions.
He randomly picked a silver-gray first-level storage, and then picked a blue and a green one. He bought three in total and spent a total of thirty silver coins.
